_ResolveAutomaticYoloForAgentBinding returns `true` (enables automatic Yolo) when both `scopeToDefaultProvider` and `usesSettingsDefaultProvider` are false (line 2099). That means tabs with other kinds of provider overrides (for example layout-restored overrides via Tab::SetAgentOverride) can still inherit the persisted Yolo preference even when their current provider does not match the Settings default, which appears to contradict the PR goal/spec of scoping automatic Yolo to the Settings default provider only.

This test hard-codes the number of SettingsEditor locales as 16. That adds fragility (the repo already enumerates locale folders dynamically) and doesn’t add coverage beyond verifying the iteration worked. Prefer asserting against the discovered folder count instead of a fixed number so adding/removing locales won’t break the selftest.
